fieldValues.title: What does a flagged tension do?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the precedent checks (Research: Protocol evolution, part 3). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Nothing by itself: it is a note for the secretary, kept or dismissed.
- B. A relation in the governance package (in tension with), from the new record to the standing one, with the reason.
- C. It blocks a lifecycle transition (proposed to ratified) until someone rules on it.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How many flags a secretary keeps; whether a kept flag should survive into the decision register.
fieldValues.next_action: Have the secretary triage the 89 checks from the two meetings and count.
